results.content:
Title: Crustdata: People and company search APIs built for AI agents | Product Hunt
# Crustdata. ## People and company search APIs built for AI agents. Crustdata was ranked #4 of the week for November 6th, 2024. Crustdata was ranked #2 of the day for November 6th, 2024. People Dataset was ranked #3 of the day for May 28th, 2025. Web search API by Crustdata was ranked #2 of the day for January 22nd, 2026. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads. Web search API by Crustdata. Launched on November 6th, 2024. You hand them a few filters, they run those filters in a black box, and they hand back a list. Every recruiter on the same tool runs the same filters and pulls the same people, which means the judgment that makes you good at this never actually makes it into the search. CrustRecruiter is a set of skills you install into Claude via MCP. Claude does the thinking, Crustdata does the manual work. Claude handles the reasoning and remembers your taste, while Crustdata handles everything that used to eat your day, like pulling profiles from 800M+ candidates, verifying emails, mapping markets, and syncing your ATS. 🔎 Sourcing: Hand over a JD, a recorded intake call, or just describe the role, and get a ranked shortlist with a reason behind every single pick. 🗺️ Market mapping: See how big a talent pool actually is, where those people work now, and what they earn, before you commit to a search. 🧠 Memory: Every rejection and every "more like this" you give gets remembered, so each new search starts with the feedback from all your previous ones. And here's the part we love. Every time Anthropic ships a stronger Claude, your recruiter gets smarter too, and you get that upgrade for free the day it lands. The MCP integration with Claude is a smart move as it keeps the human in the loop for the reasoning, while automating the manual grunt work. Does the API integrate smoothly with standard marketing automation hubs like HubSpot, or is it strictly optimized for custom AI agents right now? Given Crustdata's people-search roots, how much of the sourcing is live data vs.
